# Command-line reference

The command signatures below come from the running Ink Studio CLI. Use `ink-studio help` for the same usage text in the terminal.

## Usage

```text
ink-studio <command> <diorama id | lab/file.js> [options]

  help [--json]   list commands and shared options
  paint mix|ramp|table|swatches <file.json> [--out file.json]   mix pigments or bake colors
  hierarchy <graph.json> [--node id] [--parent id|world] [--out file.json]   inspect or reparent live scene nodes
  curve <family-or-splines.json> [--spline ID] [--station n] [--distance n] [--text INK] [--out file.json]   sample a curve
  cable-route plan <cable.json> --graph <scene-graph.json> [--out route.json] [--strict on]   fit and check a socket cable
  cable-route review <scene> <views.json> --out directory [--strict on]   measure visible cable gaps on approved native grids
  curve topology inspect <splines.json> [--out file.json]   describe retained control points, segments and attachments
  curve topology edit <splines.json> <operations.json> [--out file.json] [--report file.json]   preview and commit spline edits
  curve bend <splines.json> <bend.json> --at seconds [--out file.json] [--report file.json]   pose a retained spline and its attachments
  surface inspect <patch.json> [--out file.json]   report rational surface knots, trims and revision
  surface edit <patch.json> <request.json> [--out file.json] [--report file.json]   edit rational controls and trim loops
  surface sample <patch.json> <uv-pairs.json> [--out file.json]   query positions, derivatives and trim membership
  surface mesh <patch.json> [--resolution N] [--out file.json] [--report file.json]   tessellate a trimmed rational surface
  attributes init <geometry.json> <request.json> [--out file.json]   initialize a named attribute asset for a geometry domain
  attributes inspect <asset.json> [selection.json] [--out file.json]   report attribute ranges, labels and selected values
  attributes edit <asset.json> <request.json> [--out file.json] [--report file.json]   edit typed values or channel metadata by name and ID
  volume inspect <volume.json> [--out file.json]   report sparse field ranges, bounds and storage
  volume sample <volume.json> <request.json> [--out file.json]   sample named fields at world positions
  volume pack <dense.json> [--max-cells N] [--out file.json] [--report file.json]   pack dense field buffers as sparse bricks
  volume combine <left.json> <right.json> <request.json> [--out file.json] [--report file.json]   combine aligned fields over active sites
  volume resample <volume.json> <request.json> [--out file.json] [--report file.json]   regrid selected fields within a cell budget
  volume export <volume.json> <request.json> [--out file.json] [--report file.json]   export sparse, dense, slice or isosurface data
  terrain-set inspect <recipe.json> [--out file.json]   report terrain inputs, route controls and revision
  terrain-set edit <recipe.json> <request.json> [--out recipe.json] [--report file.json]   edit routes, masks and instance replacements
  terrain-set bake <recipe.json> --out directory   stitch and erode tiles, build populations, and publish chunk receipts
  terrain-set stream <manifest.json> <views.json> [--out file.json]   load verified chunks under a byte budget and select instance LODs
  ornament <pattern.json> [--format pigment|relief|tiles] [--out file]   export a wallpaper or frieze pattern
  palette plot <plot.json> [--space rgb|oklab] [--orbit degrees] [--format png|data]   render a palette in 3D
  palette extract <reference.png> [--size 32] [--alpha visible|opaque|all] [--out report.json]
  palette usage <scene> [--select JSON] [--rare-pixels 3] [--rare-share .001] [--out report.json]
  palette pairs <palette.json> [--sort distance|lightness] [--limit 12] [--scale 16] [--out directory]
  palette ramp-review [ramp.json] [--scene scene --role name] [--pixels JSON] [--out report.json]
  palette distributions <reference.png> [--scene scene | --render frame.png] [--out directory]
  palette error <scene> [--threshold .06] [--heatmap-max .20] [--region-limit 20] [--out directory]
  palette inspect <scene> --at x,y [--out report.json]   explain the palette choice at one art pixel
  effect-recipe search [words] [--input kind-or-id] [--renderer webgl2,headless] [--json]  find runnable effect recipes
  effect-recipe open <id|file.json> [--out example.json]  copy an editable recipe
  effect-recipe render <id|file.json> [--inputs edits.json] [--sample index] --out frame.png  export a recipe frame
  effect-recipe check [id|file.json] [--chrome executable] [--out report.json]  compare WebGL preview with PNG export
  effect impacts <scene> [--t seconds] [--out report.json]   read particle impacts and receiver materials
  effect transfers <scene> [--t seconds] [--out report.json]   read material pickup and deposit events
  effect inspect <scene> --at x,y [--t seconds] [--out report.json]   trace a rendered pixel to its material response and contact
  palette fit <fit.json> [--format png|data] [--tile]   fit two approved swatches and preview at native size
  palette dither-review <fit.json> [--out directory]   compare approved pairs and flag strong texture
  palette shimmer <scene> [--from 0 --to 3 --fps 12] [--camera-pan x,y,z --camera-orbit degrees] [--include-view] [--animate] [--out directory]
  palette readability <scene> [--select JSON | --plan file.json] [--directions N --times t1,t2] [--out directory]
  palette darks <scene> [--plan file.json] [--directions N --times t1,t2] [--out directory]
  palette weather <scene> [--plan file.json | --select JSON --times t1,t2] [--out directory]
  palette stages <scene> [--select JSON] [--allowed JSON] [--out directory]   review paint, lighting, grade and resolve
  palette compare <scene|checkpoint> <palettes.json> [--out directory]   apply alternatives to one captured shot
  palette sequence <plan.json> [--out directory]   allocate one pinned palette across multiple shots
  palette cvd-repair <scene> <plan.json> [--out directory]   repair weak subject/background swatches
  render/clip output: --output-palette policy.json   resolve the final raster to a shared palette
  render/clip output: --output-grade stack.json   grade the final raster before output palette resolve
  palette save-look <approved.json> [--pack pack.json] [--out pack.json]   save approved palette findings as a look
  palette check <scene> <plan.json> [--out directory]   export a PNG board and check palette assertions
  palette chart <chart.json> [--type chart] [--format png|data]   export an indexed swatch, bar or pair chart
  palette lighting <source-or-draft.json> [--approve] [--out file.json]   suggest or save named lighting ramps
  palette field <field.json> [--t seconds] [--w width --h height] [--format png|data]   render a palette field or report grayscale bands
  palette <recipe.json> [--t seconds] [--out palette.json]   sample palette recipes, paths and animation
  inspect <scene|run>         discover fields, actions, ports and entities
  environment inspect <scene|run> --at x,y,z [--t seconds] [--out report.json]   explain sky and local weather
  environment aesthetics <pack-or-bundle.json> [query] [--json]   discover named aesthetics
  probe <scene|run> --field name [--at x,y,z | --entity id] [--explain]  sample world state
  probe <scene|run> --field world/spatial-batch --spec queries.json   proximity, occupancy and sockets
  inspect|validate|probe <scene|run> --select JSON   inspect, check, or sample a look target
  probe <scene|run> --field look/sample [--select JSON | --entity ID] [--at x,y,z]   explain a baked splat
  trace <scene|run> <name>    trace a route, signal or other exposed query
    trace <scene|run> world/cause [--args JSON | --beat ID]   follow recorded decisions, inputs and events
  beat <beat-id> <report.json|watch.ndjson> [...] [--out file.json]   find the same event across inspection reports
    sim render <run|checkpoint|world> --event-effects <sheet.json> --out frame.png   render committed visual effects
    sim render <run|checkpoint|world> --consequences on|off   show or hide authored persistent visual consequences
    sim render <run|checkpoint> --beat ID --out frame.png   render the recorded event tick
  field <scene|run> <name> --spec file.json [--explain]  export a line, grid or time series
  authoring inspect <scene> [--authoring snapshot.json] [--part id]   inspect retained parts
  authoring preview <scene> <edits.json> [--authoring snapshot.json] [--image preview.png]   stage and validate edits
  authoring apply <scene> <edits.json> [--authoring snapshot.json] --out snapshot.json   save validated edits
  authoring suggest-breakable <scene> --at x,y,z [--radius 1] [--voxel .1] [--ids]   suggest a connected breakable part
  --params JSON --parameter-time SEC   supply shared controls and choose the material bake time for a diorama
  --asset-cache DIR   reuse diorama bake data across CLI invocations
  scene inspect-entities <source> [--place ID]   list promotable objects in a committed frame
  scene promote-entities <source> <selection.json> [--into scene.json] [--place ID] --out new.json   retain editable objects
  scene apply|stamp|remix|capture|upgrade|sync-prefab|history|promote <world> ...  edit or derive a world manifest
    scene upgrade <world|checkpoint> <instance> --to PREFAB [--migration FILE] [--dry-run]
    scene sync-prefab <release.json> <world ...> --out NEW_DIRECTORY | --dry-run
    scene apply <scene> <edits.json> --dry-run   preview edited paths and look targets
  sim run|resume|fork|reset|replay|verify|scrub|take|diff|sweep|render ...  run or compare fixed-tick simulations
    sim live <world|checkpoint|run> --ticks N [--queries queries.json --policy access.json --record run.json]
    sim view <world|checkpoint|run> --policy access.json --view ID [--ticks N --out view.json]   export a scoped frame
    sim fork-compare <world|checkpoint|run> <plan.json> --out directory   capture and compare two verified story branches
    sim search-staging <world|checkpoint|run> <plan.json> --out directory   find and save shortest staging replays
    sim seed-matrix <world> <plan.json> [--out report.json]   compare story outcomes, waiting, blockers, and casts across seeds
    sim run|resume <world|checkpoint|run> [--start-story document/story] [--until-stage document/story/stage]
      [--until-outcome document/story/outcome] [--until-condition condition.json] [--ticks N]   stop at a story breakpoint
    sim run|resume|fork|replay <file> --watch-story document/story[,document/story...]|all   stream story values as NDJSON
      [--watch-values stage,evidence,roles,blockers,choices,changes] [--watch-out file.ndjson]
    sim plan <world|model|checkpoint|recording>  inspect rates, signal crossings, feedback, baked inputs and resource estimates
    sim model validate|inspect|compile <model.json>  check, describe, or lower a versioned simulation model
  solver-network inspect <network.json> [--out report.json]   inspect reusable stages, typed ports and execution order
  solver-network compile <network.json> [--out model.json]   lower authored stages to a native simulation model
  solver-network run <run.json> [--out directory]   checkpoint frame branches and capture fields, particles and contacts
  fracture prepare <plan.json> [--out preparation.json]   fit feature-guided cells, hierarchy and seam constraints
  fracture compile <plan.json> [--out world.json]   compile a portable native failure scene
  fracture run <plan.json> [--out directory]   replay progressive failure and save native handoffs and checkpoints
  material-lab presets [--out presets.json]   list native elastic, grain and constraint profiles
  material-lab compile <plan.json> [--out world.json]   compose soft bodies, grains and contact surfaces
  material-lab run <plan.json> [--out directory]   record nonlinear strain, material pair impulses and work
  liquid3d compile <plan.json> [--out world.json]   lower a volume liquid and spectral ocean to a native world
  liquid3d run <plan.json> [--out directory]   simulate collider-driven 3D flow, spray and foam
  liquid3d surface|ocean|density|particles|secondary <world|checkpoint|recording> [--out file]   extract a native frame
    sim run|resume|fork <file> [--branch ID]   name the branch in committed events
    sim run <world> --workers N [--profile]   advance eligible systems in deterministic Node worker partitions
    sim run <world> --record file.json [--observations plan.json]   retain reproducible execution evidence
    sim verify <run|fixture|story-run-bundle> [--workers N]   replay and check the recorded evidence
    sim fixture <world|checkpoint|run> --out fixture.json [--from N --ticks N --actions file.json]
      [--event KIND --event-where JSON | --fault] [--minimize]   package a portable replay and event trace
    sim block-play <model> --samples N [--resume checkpoint --checkpoint file]   sample and checkpoint a fast kernel
    sim mass-properties <plan.json> [--asset-pack pack.json --out report.json]   measure physical shape and material properties
    sim remap <plan.json> [--out report.json]   conservatively transfer extensive state across discretizations
    sim discretize <plan.json> [--out compiled.json]   compile solver cells, face geometry, and boundary regions
    sim domain <domain.json> [--world world.json --section tube/index]   assemble or trace sectioned tubes at named sockets
    sim reduce <plan.json> [--out asset.json]   bake reduced geometry, response taps, or resonant modes
    sim integrate <plan.json> [--out trace.json]   integrate creator-authored state and locate substep events
    sim grid-ops <plan.json> [--out report.json]   apply finite-volume operators to a compiled grid, chart, or mesh
    sim diagnose <plan.json> [--out report.json --fail-on warning|error]   locate stability and conservation issues
    sim measure <run.json> [--out report.json]   named simulation measurements and CI assertions
    sim review <recipe.json> --out directory [--require-match]   matched audio, traces, plots, cutaways and first divergence
    sim budget <plan.json> [--out report.json --require-budget]   measure simulation and story performance against limits
    sim reference [experiment] [--suite suite.json --out report.json]   run the shipped physics benchmarks
    sim sensors <run.json> [--out report.json --wav microphones.wav]   record calibrated virtual sensors
    sim physical-audio <run.json> [--out report.json --stems directory]   route simulation signals into aligned WAV stems
    sim sound-controls <run.json|controls.json> [--out controls.json] [--at seconds | --sample index]   map and inspect sound automation
    sim controller <run.json> [--out trace.json]   replay target following, hysteresis, or PID
    sim fit-targets <plan.json> [--out report.json --require-tolerance]   fit bounded controls to measured targets
    sim fit-parameters <run.json> [--out report.json --require-tolerance]   fit native runs to weighted reference data
    sim input-compile <plan.json> [--out score.json]   compile text, IPA, MIDI, recordings, and cues
    sim input-edit <score.json> <edits.json> [--out score.json]   edit events and rebuild curves
    sim input-export <score.json> [bindings.json] --kind recording|events|gesture   use editable input scores
    sim gesture-score <score.json> [--t seconds | --tick N | --from-tick N --to-tick N --every N]   sample authored and limited targets
    sim boundaries <asset.json> [--t seconds --dt seconds]   inspect reusable boundary and source laws
    sim solve <plan.json> [--out report.json --require-convergence]   solve dense, tridiagonal, sparse, or bracketed scalar systems
    sim network <run.json> [--out trace.json]   simulate a lumped effort/flow network and its sources
    sim waves <run.json> [--out trace.json --wav audition.wav]   render distributed or delay-line pressure and flow
    sim excite <run.json> [--out trace.json --wav force.wav]   render contact impulses, slip, and excitation forces
    sim resonator bake <plan.json> | render <run.json> [--out file.json --wav sound.wav]   bake or audition single or coupled resonant modes
    sim sections <plan.json> [--out report.json]   measure mesh, SDF, or contour sections along a path
    sim model-changes <plan> [--samples N --resume file --checkpoint file]   play prepared parameter ramps and topology swaps
    sim block-check <model> <plan> [--candidate trace.json] [--trace-out file.json]   compare sample block partitions
    --trace-steps [N]   retain actual solver inputs and state for debugging
    sim diff <run|world> [<run|world>] --first [--from N] [--ticks N]   locate the first divergence
    sim run <world> --checkpoint file.json --checkpoint-store DIR   reuse snapshot blocks across checkpoints and runs
    sim scrub <world|checkpoint|run> --ticks N,N [--checkpoint FILE]   seek in the given order
    sim take <world|checkpoint|run> --from N --ticks N --entity ID [--part ID] --out take.json
      --tracks FILE selects capture channels and --every N sets the sampling stride
    sim regions <world|run> --stream ID [--regions IDs | --near X,Y,Z --radius N] [--since snapshot.json]
    sim regions-apply <snapshot.json> <update.json>   reconstruct a scoped snapshot
    sim dependencies <scene|run|driver.js> [--ticks N] [--actions file] [--out report.json]   report spatial rebuilds
    sim sweep <world|run> <cases.json>   use look cases to compare one fixed simulation snapshot
    sim sweep <world|checkpoint|run> <observations.json>   sample scheduled observations across seeds and settings
  compare <scene|run> --looks cases.json [--out sheet.png]   compare look variants on the same view
  compare <scene> --curve-modes --w 160 --h 96 [--t 0 | --from 0 --to 3 --fps 12] [--out directory]
    --comparison side-by-side|swipe|difference   compose exactly two look cases into one image
    --divider 0.5 --swipe-axis x|y --difference-channel luminance|red|green|blue --difference-gain 3
  look inspect <scene|run|look-file> [--renderer headless|webgl]   list bindings, dependencies and targets
  look sample <look-file> [--look pack/look] [--colors JSON | --chart] [--out file.json|chart.png]
  look bake <look-file> [--format auto|palette|lut] [--swatches file] [--size N] [--out bundle.json]
  look parity [--chrome path] [--hardware] [--strict] [--out report.json]   check CPU and WebGL look fixtures
  look profile [--renderer headless|webgl|both] [--frames N] [--warmup N] [--splats N] [--w N --h N]
    [--batch N] [--chrome path] [--hardware] [--out report.json]   benchmark look setup and frame time
  look import <file> [--out pack.json] [--id pack/look]   import a LUT or palette as a versioned look
  look export <file> [--out file | --format json|cube|gpl|pal|hex]   convert or sample a look
    --look pack/look --params JSON --size N --swatches palette-file --report report.json --exact
  lut import <file.cube|file.json> [--out file.json]  load a 3D color table as native JSON
    --input-space space --output-space space --input-range min,max --output-range min,max
    --input-out-of-range preserve|clamp|error --output-out-of-range preserve|clamp|error --domain-policy clamp|error|extrapolate

  shape capture <recipe.js|shape.json> [--out dir] [--yaw degrees,...] [--pitch degrees] export editable silhouettes
  shape capture <recipe.js|shape.json> --views plan.json [--out dir] [--cell size] export approved perspective silhouettes
  shape fit <capture-dir> [--out shape.json] [--growth voxels] [--review dir] fit a shared voxel proxy

  scenes                      list every diorama
  show-bridge [--port 8181] [--osc-in 9002]   open live audio, timecode, stage and projection control
    --dmx-host IP --dmx-protocol artnet|sacn --universe N   configure a physical lighting destination
  catalog [words] [--full] [--json] [--all]   search features or the complete public reference
  stats <id>                  splat counts, colours used, size, cost per frame, warnings
  render <id> [--t 1.5]       one PNG rendered on the CPU
  bounce-probes bake <scene> [--bounce-probes settings.json] --out probes.json
  bounce-probes sample <scene> --at x,y,z --normal x,y,z [--bounce-probes probes.json]
  bounce-probes review <scene> --out directory [--from 0 --to 3 --fps 12 --w 184 --h 112]
  traced-lighting <scene> --out asset.json [--plan settings.json --t 0 --samples 32 --bounces 2]
  splat-fit <scene> --plan approvals.json --out asset.json
  splat-groups <scene> --plan groups.json --out fit.json [--base fit.json --report report.json]
  splat-redistribute <scene> --plan operations.json --out fit.json --report review.json [--base fit.json]
  render/clip --shot-corrections file.json|off   load or bypass native shot corrections
  render or clip --multiprojection plan.json   use local projection for named mesh surfaces
  path-ink <scene> --plan look.json --out frame.png [--t 0 | --from 0 --to 2 --fps 12]
  sdf-reference <scene> --out directory [--t 0,1.2 --w 192 --h 120 --samples 32 --bounces 3]
  physical-reference <plan.json> --out directory [--quality studio --samples 32 --bounces 4 --batch 16 --denoise gentle --resume accumulation.bin]
  hybrid-cage <scene.js> --plan file.json [--out directory --w pixels --h pixels --raw]   preview a shared mesh, strand, and splat deformation
  sculpt-detail <scene> --plan file.json [--out directory --object id --t 1.2]   review and reproject sculpt relief
  sculpt-contribution list <scene.json> --solid id   list retained contributions in order
  sculpt-contribution inspect <scene.json> --solid id --id contribution   compare with the contribution muted
  sculpt-contribution edit <scene.json> <edit.json> --out scene.json   edit one contribution and report dependencies
  assembly-review inspect <scene.json> <review.json>   list visibility, locks and reveal scope
  assembly-review render <scene.json> <review.json> --out image.png   render an independent review
  assembly-review check <scene.json> <review.json> <candidate.json>   check a draft against frozen items
  assembly-stretch plan <scene.json> <stretch.json> [--preview scene.json]   check a stretch from two picks
  assembly-stretch apply <scene.json> <stretch.json> --out scene.json   carry a connected assembly through the stretch
  sculpt-split plan <scene.json> <split.json>   report a complementary sculpt split
  sculpt-split apply <scene.json> <split.json> --out scene.json   save separate sculpt pieces
  sculpt-stamp place <scene.json> <stamp.json> <placement.json> --out scene.json   add and carve one compound stamp
  sculpt-guide plan <scene.json> <operation.json>   preview mirrored or radial copies
  sculpt-guide apply <scene.json> <operation.json> --out scene.json   retain a guided stroke or stamp
  sculpt-guide update <scene.json> <edit.json> --out scene.json   revise an existing guided operation
  sculpt-guide inspect <scene.json>   report generated copies and placements
  painting-3d plan <scene.json> <placement.json>   validate attachment slots and mark contacts
  painting-3d apply <scene.json> <placement.json> --out scene.json   retain a 3D painting
  painting-3d update <scene.json> <edit.json> --out scene.json   edit marks, profiles, erasers, boil, order or placement
  painting-3d inspect <scene.json>   report marks and resolved attachments
  painting-3d extract <scene.json> --id painting --out painting.json   export a reusable painting
  painting-cels init <scene.json> --id painting --out clip.json [--fps 12 --playback loop]   start with an editable 3D painting
  painting-cels inspect <clip.json>   list cel IDs, mark IDs, and holds
  painting-cels edit <scene.json> <clip.json> <edit.json> --out clip.json   insert, retime, or edit retained cels
  painting-cels sample <scene.json> <clip.json> --out scene.json [--frame cel-1 | --at seconds]   write one editable cel into the scene
  painting-cels preview <scene.json> <clip.json> --out directory [--frame cel-1 | --at seconds] [--view view.json]   render neighboring poses in one camera
  painting-cels export <scene.json> <clip.json> --out directory [--view view.json]   render held exposures and animated PNG
  painting-flow sample <scene.json> <plan.json> [--at seconds] --out scene.json   advect retained marks through a painted field
  painting-flow bake <scene.json> <plan.json> [--from seconds --fps 12 --frames 24 --playback once] --out clip.json   bake editable flow poses into cels
  paint-survival review <scene.json> <plan.json> --out directory   compare painted fallbacks across native grids and angles
  paint-survival apply <scene.json> <plan.json> <review.json> --case angle/resolution --out scene.json   accept one reviewed paint variant
  sculpt-spray plan <scene.json> <brush.json>   capture receivers for a volumetric paint brush
  sculpt-spray apply <scene.json> <brush.json> --out scene.json   retain a shaped surface tint
  sculpt-spray inspect <scene.json>   show retained volumes and receiver coverage
  sculpt-snap plan <scene.json> <stroke.json>   preview a surface or root stroke snap
  sculpt-snap apply <scene.json> <stroke.json> --out scene.json   write a retained snapped stroke
  sculpt-snap inspect <scene.json> --target solid --id stroke   sample the live attachment
  sculpt-sweep add <scene.json> <sweep.json> [--target solid] --out scene.json   add a retained shaped sweep
  sculpt-sweep cut <scene.json> <sweep.json> --target solid --out scene.json   carve a retained sweep into a solid
  sculpt-sweep update <scene.json> <edit.json> [--target solid] --out scene.json   revise a saved sweep
  sculpt-sweep inspect <scene.json> --id sweep [--target solid]   report retained poses and sampling
  sculpt-masks <scene> [--plan file.json --out directory --object id --t 1.2]   apply and review retained sculpt masks
  sdf-shape-review <scene> [--out directory --object id --profile file.json --t 1.2 --fail-on-flags]   compare direct and remeshed SDF views
  pose-correctives capture <scene> --plan sculpt.json --t 1 --out correction.json
  pose-correctives review <scene> --out directory [--from 0 --to 2.4 --fps 10]
  render/clip/atlas --pose-correctives patch.json|off   load or bypass puppet corrective sculpts
  render/clip/atlas --view-poses asset.json|off   load or bypass view-sector pose corrections
  render/clip --volume-scale 3 --volume-reconstruction object|depth|lighting   choose a coarse fog reconstruction
  render/clip --volume-stochastic 4 --volume-stochastic-history 12   trial sparse scattering in one static fog field
  protected-lod-review <scene> --plan file.json [--out directory] [--fail-on-hold]   verify protected details at approved distances and poses
  render-suite [--scene gatehouse|signal-coil|night] [--profile file.json] [--out directory]   compare matched art-grid renders
  relief-review <scene> --plan file.json [--out directory]   compare geometry, normal relief and texel paint on matched art grids
  relief-review approve <report.json> --choices file.json --out approval.json   save the reviewed tier per asset and camera range
  modeling-benchmark prepare --out directory   package four pinned modeling tasks
  modeling-benchmark start <suite> <task> --participant id --kind person|agent|script --workflow id --tool-revision revision --out directory   start a matched attempt

any command that plays a diorama takes --poke 2:x,y,z (tap it at 2 seconds, toward that point; several with ;)
sun options: --live-sun on|off --sun-direction x,y,z --sun-ambient n --sun-intensity n --shadow-map-size n --shadow-bias n --sun-shadows off --shadow-strand-spans n --shadow-strand-layers n
shadow art: --shadow-art file.json|off for baked JSON scenes and live sun
color clusters: --color-clusters file.json|off for material-specific cluster size, grain and protection
pass quality: --pass-quality file.json|off for background, particles and secondary reflections
shot lighting: --shot-lighting on|off|file.json   scope lights, channel ramps and spill
reflection detail: --reflection-detail on|off   compare the authored core, streaks and distance clusters
selective transparency: --splat-order selective --transparency-settings file.json --transparency-report file.json
reflection proxies: --reflection-proxies on|off and render --reflection-report file.json
brushwork: --brushwork on|off   compare surface-aligned paint at export size
shadow bands: --shadow-band-paint on|off   compare painted lighting thresholds
diffuse ramps: --diffuse-ramps on|off   compare authored diffuse ramps
shade normals: --shade-normals on|off   compare authored diffuse normals
detail-preserving relighting: --relighting on|off|file.json --sky-time seconds
bounce options: --sky-bounce color|preset|off --ground-bounce color|preset|off --sky-bounce-intensity n --ground-bounce-intensity n
cloud options: --cloud-field cirrus|coastal-stratus|cumulus|storm-front|file.json|off --cloud-representation auto|card|impostor|volume|off --cloud-self-shadows on|off --cloud-shadows on|off --cloud-shadow-strength 0..1 --cloud-shadow-softness units
translucent silhouette options: --translucent-silhouettes file.json|off
curve splats: render or clip a curve-splat-scene JSON with --curve-mode splats|curves. --curve-splats off shows the legacy carriers.
    --curve-width file.json|off   art-pixel width rules for curve materials
    --curve-subdivision on|off|pixels   refine finite spans for the target art grid
    --curve-lod on|off   authored curve distance simplification and aggregation
motional pixel coverage: --motional-coverage on|off|file.json
celestial options: --celestial-tracks on|off|file.json
sky options: --sky-environment file.json|off --sky-time seconds --sky-profile track=profile --sky-transitions file.json|off --sky-reflections scene|material
weather options: --weather-binding on|off|file.json --retained-weather on|off --weather-fronts on|off --weather-tracks on|off --world-precipitation on|off|file.json --rain-impacts on|off|file.json
wind options: --wind-field on|off|file.json
lightning options: --lightning on|off|file.json
exposure options: --scene-exposure on|off|file.json
aerial options: --aerial-perspective on|off --aerial-start units --aerial-density per-unit --aerial-contrast 0..1
view options: --surface off (no finish layers) --pbr-materials file.json|off --pbr-shadows on|off --pbr-specular-sampling on|off --facing-colors off --directional-colors off --water off --reflections off --reflection-probes off --transmission off --surface-detail-kits off --atmosphere off --edges off (no edge sprites) --yaw --pitch --zoom 2 --target x,y,z --w 900 --h 620 --px 2 (screen pixels per art pixel) --px1 (native art pixels) --tone stipple|off --raw (no palette) --colored (smooth body-colored contours) --fine (inked detail: colours looked up per pixel) --bounce (bounce light baked in) --focus x,y,z[,near,far,coarse] (uneven detail) --follow [stretch,broad] (dabs along the form) --adaptive-sampling on|off|file.json --clean (remove lone pixels) --camera-shot id --ortho [on|off] (override authored projection) --cols 4 --out file.png --seed n
socket emitter options: --atmosphere-emitters on|off|file.json
animated splat options: --splat-fields on|off|file.json
sprite options: --sprite-atlas on|off|atlas.json --sprite-at x,y,z --sprite-scale n --sprite-atlas-mode card|impostor|scenery --sprite-reconstruction auto|geometry|sprite --impostor-blend nearest|depth-reprojected --protected-lod guard.json|off
                --sprite-cels edits.json|off --sprite-playback once|loop
shaped fog options: --shaped-atmosphere on|off|file.json --volume-cutouts on|off|file.json
atmosphere bands: --atmosphere-depth-bands on|off|file.json
shoreline options: --shore-foam on|off
lighting options: --highlight-cels on|off --cutout-shadows on|off --shadow-shells on|off --volume-local-lights on|off --volume-local-shadows on|off
silhouette protection: --silhouette-protection on|off|file.json
joint load priorities: --joint-priority file.json|off
shared focus track: --focus-track file.json|off
layered horizon: --horizon-bands on|off|file.json
staging: --fov radians | --focal-length mm [--sensor-height mm] --focus-distance units --composition u,v --camera-staging on|off|file.json --camera-guides [on|off] --depth-of-field [on|off]
art direction: --art-direction on|off|painted-pixel|storm-silhouette|soft-dawn|file.json
shared rendering: --strict-contract [on|off] --step-animation [on|off]
  render <id> --compatibility-report [on|off]   save WebGL compatibility beside the preview
  clip <id> --compatibility-report [on|off]   save WebGL compatibility across the previewed frames
effect palette options: --effect-palettes on|off|file.json
asset art rules: --art-rules design.json [--art-frame id] [--art-shot id]
art options: --palette-remap off --color-curves off --lut <file.cube|file.json|off> --color-stack <file.json|off> --ink on|off|file.json --ink-shot file.json --effects off --emissive-finishes off --stable on|off|file.json --stable-detail on|off|file.json --coverage-filter on|off|file.json --surface-history on|off|file.json --protected-pixels on|off|file.json --edge-filter on|off|file.json --contact-shadows on|off|file.json --area-lights on|off|file.json --bounce-probes on|off|file.json --snap on|off --dither-space screen|world|object|view --dither-spacing n --dither-origin x,y,z --resolve native|coverage|clusters --splat-order center|surface|selective --transparency-settings file.json --splat-coverage legacy|continuous|soft --splat-footprints on|off --palette-sampling off --semantic-mipmaps off --simulation-material-layers off --relief-lod auto|geometry|normal|painted|off --render-grid hex|triangle|diamond|off --grid-size 8 --grid-angle 0 --grid-aspect 1 --grid-gap 0 --grid-origin x,y --sdf-assist on|posed|off|file.json --traced-lighting file.json|off --splat-fit file.json|off --surface-decals off --stable-transparency on|off|blend --fragment-budget N --inspection file.json|off --inspection-focus id --composite file.json|off --cutaway file.json|off --render-graph file.json|off --shutter on|off|file.json --afterimages file.json|off --reconstruction file.json|off --volume-scale 2 --volume-steps 8 --volume-jitter off|blue-noise|spatiotemporal
```
